{{{{{1|Animal Infobox}}} |title = Bear (Animal) |image = Bear Animal Anim.gif |image2 = Bear animal side |Building = [[Premium Barn]] |mPrice = 14000 |sellprice = 28000 |item 1 = {{Name|Honey Jar}} }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a type of custom farm animal that live in the [[Premium Barn]]. A {{PAGENAME}} can be purchased from [[Stardew:Marnie's Ranch|Marnie's Ranch]] for {{Price|14000}} once the player meets with the [[Bear]] via the [[Stardew:secret notes|Secret Note 23]], and afterward triggers a specific event in front of Marnie's Ranch. A {{PAGENAME}} cannot become pregnant and give birth. A {{PAGENAME}} does not require any grass or hay to maintain, and won't receive any friendship penalty from starvation, even in winter. Note that they'll still roam out of the barns when the gates are open. According to the [[Bear]], they seem to prefer living in the [[Premium Barn]], but they can still be relocated to other types of barn buildings. ==Produce== {|class="wikitable" !Image !Name !Description !Sell Price ![[File:Rancher.png|24px|link=Stardew:Farming#Skills]] Rancher Profession
(+20% sell price) |- |[[File:Honey Jar.png]] |[[Honey Jar]] |{{Description|Honey Jar}} |{{Qualityprice|Honey Jar|1000|dsv=false}} |{{Qualityprice|Honey Jar|ceil(1.2*1000)|dsv=false}} |} ==Reproduction== A {{PAGENAME}} cannot get pregnant and reproduce. ==Selling== A {{PAGENAME}} can be sold at any time, and their value will depend on the level of friendship achieved. The maximum selling price is {{Price|43400}} (at full hearts).
